normalized.result: Yes, that fits exactly. When I search from my main library, archived stuff should stay out of the way — that's the whole point of archiving. But I don't want it truly lost, so having its own search and tag filtering inside the Archive, so I can still dig something up when I deliberately go looking there, is just right. Tucked away from everyday view, but still findable on purpose.
